feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Colette Kress becomes Nvidia's interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigns
entry.summary: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang is out, and the company's chief financial officer Colette Kress is taking over as interim CEO. She'll have to guide the company through an exceptionally challenging time.

entry.title: Nvidia's interim CEO inherits risky AI bets and a legal mess
entry.summary: AI expert Gary Marcus breaks down what's at stake for Nvidia and the mess its new CEO has inherited.

entry.title: Investigation into what cause deadly Brooklyn building collapse continues
entry.summary: Investigators are trying to find out what went wrong after an apartment building collapsed into a nearby construction site in Brooklyn, New York, killing at least eight people.

entry.title: These swing voters have low expectations for divided government
entry.summary: Key voters in North Carolina are pessimistic the blue wave flipping control of Congress will solve their economic woes. Many say President Trump will be the chief obstacle.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: What's next for Nvidia after CEO's resignation, Trump's reliance on former Nvidia CEO in flux ahead of China trip, Trump's envoys hope to get Europe involved in Russia-Ukraine peace talks.

entry.title: Rachel Maddow says the Justice Department is collapsing. Can it be saved?
entry.summary: Was the Justice Department ever really above politics? Rachel Maddow digs into its surprising past to explain why she believes its future is at stake.

entry.title: Trump confronts dwindling options to end conflict with Iran
entry.summary: After President Trump's midterm election losses and Israel's ongoing political shakeup, Gulf countries are stuck in limbo as Trump's options to end the war in Iran dwindle.

entry.title: Microsoft investigating widespread outage that took email and other apps offline
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Andrew Couts of WIRED about a widespread outage of Microsoft products that has disrupted the life and work of thousands of people.

entry.title: Why France -- despite its size -- is losing the trust of the market
entry.summary: Many rich countries have what have historically been considered very high debt loads. Yet France is being singled out and punished by the markets recently. The reason is credibility.

entry.title: Newly elected lawmakers come to D.C. for freshmen orientation
entry.summary: Newly elected lawmakers are in Washington, D.C., this week for orientation, where members learn everything from committees and ethics rules to where the bathrooms are.
